recommendation.summary: Recommended mix: Cover crop – soybean – vetch – sorghum: rank 1 of 7, 73 points (range 61–84).
recommendation.why: This rotation is recommended because it adds plant cover in winter, diversifies the system (4 distinct crops vs. 2), adds legumes that supply nitrogen, cuts months of bare soil (from 6.0 to 2.0 per year) and lowers the crops' exposure to drought, heat and pest or disease problems. It has the highest score with balanced priorities. However, it increases estimated water demand (6 % more than the current one), lowers estimated relative income, requires terminate the cover crop in time (August-September) so the soil profile recharges before the summer crop and requires obtain cover-crop seed and budget for planting and termination costs.
